name: Anemone

project_scope.admission_note: Both source-pool species learner-approved; county-native status UNRESOLVED for each. Anemone edwardsiana var. edwardsiana is a separate future source-pool identity, not silently merged into this pair.

shared_genus_characters.look_here_first: Find the basal leaves and the leaflike involucral bracts on the flower stalk; count bract tiers and measure each tier's position relative to the full scape before focusing on petaloid sepals.
shared_genus_characters.shared: Spring herbaceous perennials with basal divided leaves, solitary flower with petaloid sepals (not petals), numerous stamens and an achene head.

species_comparison_matrix.look_first: ONE bract tier ABOVE scape midpoint
species_comparison_matrix.basal_leaves: All basal leaves dissimilar to involucral bracts
species_comparison_matrix.caution: Do not confuse illegitimate later homonym A. caroliniana Torr. & A.Gray with A. caroliniana Walter.

species_comparison_matrix.look_first: ONE bract tier BELOW scape midpoint
species_comparison_matrix.basal_leaves: At least one basal leaf similar in division to involucral bracts
species_comparison_matrix.caution: Sepal color and count overlap A. berlandieri.

species_comparison_matrix.taxon: Anemone edwardsiana (comparison; not installed in this batch)
species_comparison_matrix.basal_leaves: Check mature achenes for variety-level determination
species_comparison_matrix.caution: Source pool specifically lists var. edwardsiana; do not create an undifferentiated duplicate card.

decision_sequence: Photograph the full flowering scape including ground-level basal leaves.
Count tiers of involucral bracts: TWO → investigate A. edwardsiana; ONE → continue.
For ONE tier, compare tier position to midpoint: ABOVE favors A. berlandieri; BELOW favors A. caroliniana.
Compare several basal leaves to bracts: all different → A. berlandieri; at least one similar → A. caroliniana.
If scape is broken or bracts hidden, leave identification at Anemone rather than forcing a flower-color ID.
diagnostic_photo_checklist: full scape with visible midpoint and bract tier
flower face for basic species recognition
overlap_and_cautions: A. caroliniana Walter and A. caroliniana Torr. & A.Gray are different nomenclatural concepts; the latter is a later illegitimate homonym under A. berlandieri.
Both current species are learner-approved but native-range UNRESOLVED by strict project county threshold.
Single provisional photos do not show all diagnostic bract-tier characters.
